# E12 T1 report

**Status: incomplete. E12 is not ready for acceptance.** Local mechanisms pass; the whole epic, its real-stack tests and several required gates remain unfinished or failing.

## Built

- `hub/src/crew_health/tools/domain/{scope,phase,denials,tool_result,support,context,retrieval,errors}.py`: frozen scope/result/effect/context values, all origin modes, separate support uses, failed-value removal, future-time rejection, mandatory observation/answer retention, and typed kernel errors.
- `hub/src/crew_health/tools/application/{ports,gateway,context_builder,retrieval_service,effects,policy_service}.py`: turn-bounded dispatch, stage/schema/scope checks, sanitized audit calls, bounded results, exact-pin rank fusion and citation reads, eligible neighbor expansion, separate non-supporting history, complete-serialization budget checks, keyed context fingerprints, and one measurement proposal through E05 in the caller's savepoint.

- `hub/tests/tools/{fakes,test_gateway,test_context_builder,test_retrieval_service,test_effects,test_handlers,test_bench,test_policy,test_schema,test_scope,test_support}.py`: component, property, malformed-input, privacy-boundary, fault and SQLite cases.

The module still declares settings only. No production gateway/controller, HTTP route, worker, clinical projection, tokenizer, semantic verifier or effect authority is enabled by these components. Unit doubles are not acceptance evidence. The benchmark additions are a verified-file reader and scoring library, not a completed executable retrieval benchmark.

## Decisions taken

Consumer values and protocols were built in E12 rather than waiting for every provider. Boundary payloads remain immutable bytes until validated. The catalog currently supports a narrow single-stage subset and rejects unsupported exposure declarations; it does not implement E17's unfinished general exposure catalog. Public queries select exact injected public vocabulary entries, not arbitrary private free text.

E05's actual caller-UOW proposal port is used for measurements. E13 must own the task generation, validation, receipt and enclosing commit. Other proposal families remain unbound. Exact owner-authored text is the only local positive output-policy case; arbitrary clinical prose is not accepted. The real shared medicine checker remains unavailable at `hub/src/crew_health/config/application/loader.py:155`.

These boundaries are recorded as implementation answers in `docs/requests/E12.md`. They do not close its requests or certify provider agreement.

## Prevention rules

Inspect generated wrapper types before member access; a literal is not necessarily an enum or RootModel. Verify fixture paths and shapes before referencing them, and remove unused speculative scaffolding. Keep coverage-producing commands sequential so their evidence cannot race. Never ignore an unfamiliar configuration field that could narrow authority.
